content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IMSc Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IMSc to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by The Institute of Mathematical Sciences (IMSc), a premier research institution located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The positions available under this recruitment are Fellow and Reader across various academic fields such as Pure Mathematics and Theoretical Physics.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the Fellow position and 10 vacancies for the Reader position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of online applications is 15 November 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a PhD degree along with relevant postdoc experience, specifically 2 years for Fellow - E and 5 years for Reader - F.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 35 years for the Fellow - E post and 38 years for the Reader - F post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Central Government pay scales and allowances corresponding to Pay Level 12 for Fellow and Pay Level 13 for Reader.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official IMSc recruitment portal and uploading a single PDF containing their CV, publication list, and research plan.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an initial screening of applications, evaluation by experts, a research seminar by shortlisted candidates, interaction with faculty, and final committee recommendations.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of IMSc?
faq.answer: The official website of The Institute of Mathematical Sciences can be accessed at www.imsc.res.in for all detailed notifications and updates.
